diff --git a/serpent/context_requirements.py b/serpent/context_requirements.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..506a4ee
--- /dev/null
+++ b/serpent/context_requirements.py
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+"""Pre-reader context assessment from independent source graphs, never predictions.
+
+Scores are ordinal annotation severity, not probabilities. Labels concern
+reference grounding separately from grammatical READ extraction. No world facts
+or physical observations are fabricated from the presence of a pronoun.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+from serpent.serialization import canonical_bytes
+
+VERSION = "context-requirements-2"
+
+
+def provided_context(history=(), entities=()):
+    """Author-supplied context evidence; mentions are not truth or coreference."""
+    turns = []
+    ids = set()
+    for i, turn in enumerate(history, 1):
+        identifier = turn.get("id", f"turn-{i}")
+        if not isinstance(identifier, str) or not identifier or identifier in ids:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate or invalid turn ID")
+        if turn.get("role") not in ("user", "assistant", "system", "tool") or not isinstance(
+            turn.get("content"), str
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("turn requires role and exact content")
+        ids.add(identifier)
+        turns.append(
+            dict(
+                id=identifier,
+                role=turn["role"],
+                content=turn["content"],
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(turn["content"].encode()).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    records = []
+    entity_ids = set()
+    for entity in entities:
+        identifier = entity.get("id")
+        if not isinstance(identifier, str) or not identifier or identifier in entity_ids:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate or invalid entity ID")
+        entity_ids.add(identifier)
+        mentions = []
+        name = entity.get("name")
+        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
+            for turn in turns:
+                for m in re.finditer(
+                    r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(name) + r"(?!\w)", turn["content"], re.I
+                ):
+                    mentions.append(
+                        dict(turn_id=turn["id"], start=m.start(), end=m.end(), text=m.group())
+                    )
+        records.append(
+            dict(
+                id=identifier,
+                record=deepcopy(entity),
+                mentions=mentions,
+                provenance="fixture_supplied_WORLD",
+                truth_status="author_supplied",
+            )
+        )
+    return dict(
+        version="context-ledger-1",
+        previous_turns=turns,
+        world_entities=records,
+        claims=[],
+        history_supplied=bool(turns),
+        world_supplied=bool(records),
+        semantics="supplied evidence; mentions do not resolve references or verify assertions",
+    )
+
+
+def assess_case(case, *, history=(), entities=()):
+    value = case.to_dict() if hasattr(case, "to_dict") else case
+    atoms = value["atoms"]
+    resolved = {r["from"] for r in value["relations"] if r["type"] == "REFERS_TO"}
+    reasons = []
+    channels = set()
+    level = 0
+    blocks_read = False
+    for atom in atoms:
+        f = atom["features"]
+        if atom["type"] == "REFERENCE" and atom["id"] not in resolved:
+            # An implicit addressee is not missing grammatical content.
+            if f.get("role") == "addressee":
+                continue
+            channels.update(("previous_turns", "world"))
+            if f.get("lemma") in ("it", "them", "this", "that", "these", "those"):
+                channels.add("real_world")
+            level = max(level, 1)
+            reasons.append({"kind": "unresolved_reference", "source": atom["id"]})
+        if f.get("determiner") in ("this", "these", "that", "those") or f.get("lemma") in (
+            "here",
+            "there",
+        ):
+            channels.update(("previous_turns", "world", "real_world"))
+            level = max(level, 1)
+            reasons.append({"kind": "deictic_grounding", "source": atom["id"]})
+        if f.get("lemma") in ("yesterday", "today", "tomorrow", "now"):
+            channels.add("world")
+            level = max(level, 1)
+            reasons.append({"kind": "clock_anchor", "source": atom["id"]})
+        if f.get("context_mode") == "withheld":
+            channels.update(("previous_turns", "world"))
+            level = max(level, 1)
+            reasons.append({"kind": "withheld_context", "source": atom["id"]})
+    for gap in value["gaps"]:
+        kind = gap["kind"]
+        reasons.append(
+            {"kind": kind, "source": gap["id"], "candidate_count": len(gap["candidates"])}
+        )
+        if kind in ("missing", "ellipsis"):
+            level = max(level, 3)
+            channels.add("previous_turns")
+            blocks_read = True
+        elif kind == "unresolved_attachment":
+            level = max(level, 2)
+            channels.update(("previous_turns", "world"))
+            blocks_read = True
+        elif kind == "unresolved_reference":
+            level = max(level, 2 if len(gap["candidates"]) > 1 else 1)
+            channels.update(("previous_turns", "world"))
+    # Channels are alternatives, not an assertion that all are required.
+    return {
+        "version": VERSION,
+        "case_id": value["id"],
+        "provided_context": provided_context(history, entities),
+        "sentence_sha256": hashlib.sha256(value["sentence"].encode()).hexdigest(),
+        "requires_context": bool(channels),
+        "needs_previous_turns": "possible" if "previous_turns" in channels else "not_indicated",
+        "needs_world": "possible" if "world" in channels else "not_indicated",
+        "real_world_needed": "possible" if "real_world" in channels else "not_indicated",
+        "channel_semantics": "alternative possible resolvers; physical sensing is not assumed mandatory",
+        "read_extraction": "unresolved_structure" if blocks_read else "score_normally",
+        "reference_grounding": "context_required"
+        if channels
+        else "no_external_requirement_identified",
+        "ambiguity_score": level / 3,
+        "ambiguity_level": level,
+        "score_kind": "ordinal_context_and_ambiguity_burden_not_probability",
+        "assessment_scope": "explicit source graph evidence; absence of a flag is not a universal guarantee",
+        "reasons": reasons,
+    }
+
+
+def context_report(cases):
+    return {"version": VERSION, "cases": [assess_case(c) for c in cases]}
+
+
+def validate_context_report(report, cases):
+    expected = context_report(cases)
+    if report.get("version") == "context-requirements-1":
+        expected["version"] = "context-requirements-1"
+        for row in expected["cases"]:
+            row["version"] = "context-requirements-1"
+            row.pop("provided_context")
+    if canonical_bytes(report) != canonical_bytes(expected):
+        raise ValueError("context report does not match independent source graphs")
+
+
+def matches_policy(annotation, policy="account", max_ambiguity=1.0):
+    if policy not in ("account", "self-contained", "read-resolvable"):
+        raise ValueError("unknown context policy")
+    if not 0 <= max_ambiguity <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("ambiguity threshold must be in [0, 1]")
+    if annotation["ambiguity_score"] > max_ambiguity:
+        return False
+    if policy == "self-contained":
+        return not annotation["requires_context"]
+    if policy == "read-resolvable":
+        return annotation["read_extraction"] == "score_normally"
+    return True
diff --git a/tests/test_context_requirements.py b/tests/test_context_requirements.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..957f787
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_context_requirements.py
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from serpent.context_requirements import assess_case, context_report, validate_context_report
+from serpent.planner import Options, build_pool
+from serpent.publish import publish_pack
+from serpent.scenarios import reference_case
+from serpent.validate import validate_pack_directory
+
+
+class ContextRequirementsTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.pool, _ = build_pool(3, Options(noise="off", typos="off"))
+
+    def test_unresolved_reference_still_has_read_roles(self):
+        c = reference_case("S000001", "v_move")
+        a = assess_case(c)
+        self.assertTrue(a["requires_context"])
+        self.assertEqual(a["read_extraction"], "score_normally")
+        self.assertEqual(a["real_world_needed"], "possible")
+
+    def test_internal_reference_is_not_external(self):
+        cases = [i.case for i in self.pool if any(r.type == "REFERS_TO" for r in i.case.relations)]
+        self.assertTrue(cases)
+        for c in cases:
+            self.assertFalse(assess_case(c)["requires_context"])
+
+    def test_demonstrative_is_possible_not_required_physical_context(self):
+        c = next(i.case for i in self.pool if i.case.factors.reference == "demonstrative")
+        a = assess_case(c)
+        self.assertEqual(a["real_world_needed"], "possible")
+        self.assertEqual(a["read_extraction"], "score_normally")
+
+    def test_policy_does_not_drop_context_cases_by_default(self):
+        from serpent.context_requirements import matches_policy
+
+        a = assess_case(reference_case("S000001", "v_move"))
+        self.assertTrue(matches_policy(a))
+        self.assertTrue(matches_policy(a, "read-resolvable"))
+        self.assertFalse(matches_policy(a, "self-contained"))
+        self.assertFalse(matches_policy(a, max_ambiguity=0))
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            matches_policy(a, "silent-filter")
+
+    def test_scenario_context_records_prior_turns_and_mentions(self):
+        from serpent.scenarios import generate_scenarios
+
+        for row in generate_scenarios(16, 11)["scenarios"]:
+            snapshot = row["context_requirements"]["provided_context"]
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [t["content"] for t in snapshot["previous_turns"]],
+                [t["content"] for t in row["history"]],
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(len(snapshot["world_entities"]), len(row["context"]["entities"]))
+            self.assertEqual(snapshot["claims"], [])
+            for entity in snapshot["world_entities"]:
+                self.assertTrue(entity["mentions"])
+            if row["kind"] == "withheld":
+                self.assertFalse(snapshot["history_supplied"])
+
+    def test_older_metadata_still_validates(self):
+        cases = [self.pool[0].case]
+        report = context_report(cases)
+        report["version"] = "context-requirements-1"
+        for row in report["cases"]:
+            row["version"] = "context-requirements-1"
+            row.pop("provided_context")
+        validate_context_report(report, cases)
+
+    def test_report_tampering_rejected(self):
+        cases = [self.pool[0].case]
+        report = context_report(cases)
+        report["cases"][0]["ambiguity_score"] = 0.123
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            validate_context_report(report, cases)
+
+    def test_published_before_consumption_and_required(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+            p = publish_pack(
+                3, 7, options=Options(noise="off", typos="off"), destination=Path(tmp) / "pack"
+            )
+            self.assertTrue((p / "context-requirements.json").exists())
+            validate_pack_directory(p)
+            (p / "context-requirements.json").unlink()
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                validate_pack_directory(p)
diff --git a/docs/context-requirements.rst b/docs/context-requirements.rst
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3787d00
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/context-requirements.rst
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+Pre-reader context labels (generator 1.2.0)
+==========================================
+
+Independent defect: Serpent can emit a complete grammatical READ graph for
+"Move it" with an unresolved-reference gap, or a demonstrative noun phrase
+without a supplied referent. Packs previously had no uniform pre-reader field
+telling a consumer whether to score grammatical extraction or external grounding.
+This distinction follows from Serpent's own graphs, not downstream READ failures.
+
+New packs include context-requirements.json, assessed before publication from
+source atoms, reference edges and gaps. Sealed releases, v1 schemas, source gold
+and frozen packs remain unchanged. Validation recomputes the sidecar from source;
+changing, deleting or reordering its annotations is detected. Scenario rows also
+include the same sentence-local requirements; existing history and context fields
+still determine whether the supplied scenario actually resolves them.
+
+Labels include requires_context, needs_previous_turns, needs_world,
+real_world_needed, read_extraction and reference_grounding. Channel labels are
+possible or not_indicated: the graph cannot tell whether pointing, a WORLD store
+or a previous turn will resolve a demonstrative. Do not equate possible physical
+context with a mandatory sensor. WORLD includes a clock anchor for yesterday.
+Internally resolved REFERS_TO edges do not become missing external context.
+Implicit addressees are not missing grammatical arguments.
+
+Ambiguity score is a versioned ordinal burden score, not calibrated probability:
+0 = no explicit external requirement or gap identified;
+1/3 = ungrounded reference, deixis, clock anchor or withheld context;
+2/3 = explicit attachment ambiguity or multiple reference candidates;
+1 = missing content or ellipsis recorded by the source graph.
+A higher value does not predict Kobra failure. Missing context is distinguished
+from alternative interpretations in the reason records. Absence of a flag does
+not prove a sentence requires no pragmatic knowledge.
+
+matches_policy defaults to account (keep everything). self-contained excludes
+external grounding requirements; read-resolvable excludes structural gaps while
+keeping grammatically extractable unresolved pronouns. max_ambiguity is optional.
+Consumers must report original, excluded and selected denominators. Teacher-side
+labels must not be passed to the tested reader as hints or used to rewrite gold.
+
+Supplied prior context (generator 1.2.1)
+--------------------------------------
+
+Metadata version context-requirements-2 adds provided_context. Each scenario
+records the exact prior turns (IDs, roles, text, hashes), supplied WORLD entities
+and the spans of prior turns containing entity-name mentions. The original
+history/context fields remain unchanged. Standalone cases explicitly record
+empty supplied history and WORLD; this is distinct from not requiring context.
+
+These records never contain reference_gold or predicted facts. Entity-name
+mentions do not prove which entity a pronoun denotes. No automatic claims are
+extracted from prior user or assistant text; claims is explicitly empty for these
+fixtures. Existing fixture history and WORLD remain the authoritative supplied
+inputs. The recorded context does not automatically clear ambiguity requirements.
+Old version-1 context sidecars continue to validate against their original shape.
